verdict.rationale: Reader clearly scrapes a page with a single call (`r.jina.ai/<url>`), but the evidence only documents LLM-friendly Markdown/text outputs. The `x-respond-with` format selector is shown only with a `frontmatter` (Markdown + YAML) option. Nothing in the pack shows that raw HTML can be returned, so this adjacent format control earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scrape a web page with a single API call and get its raw HTML back
